{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=28|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A bomb targeting the office of [[Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam]] in [[Chaman]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan]], kills three people, including leader Maulana Mohammad Hanif, with nine more people injured. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1561086/world (Arab News)]
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**[[Houthi movement|Houthi]] rebels claim that they have captured "thousands" of enemy troops near the Saudi town of [[Najran]] following a major, deadly attack near the two countries' border. Saudi officials have not confirmed the claim. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-49866677 (BBC)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/houthis-claim-capture-thousands-saudi-troops-attack-190928144722091.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Flooding in the [[India]]n state of [[Uttar Pradesh]] kills at least 93 people and displaces thousands of others. Another 29 people were killed in [[Bihar]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-49875027 (BBC)].
*An oil tanker ship explodes in [[Ulsan]], [[South Korea]], with flames subsequently spreading to an adjacent second tanker. At least ten people are injured. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/south-korea-ship-fire-1.5301463 (CBC)]
*A coach with a flat tyre swerves into oncoming traffic and strikes a lorry head-on in [[Jiangsu]], [[China]]. The collision kills at least 36 and injures another 36. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/sep/29/china-road-crash-at-least-36-killed-as-coach-hits-truck (The Guardian)]
;International relations
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Seventy-fourth session of the United Nations General Assembly|U.N. General Assembly 74th session]], [[Rojava conflict]]
**[[Syria]]n [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates (Syria)|Foreign Minister]] [[Walid Muallem|Walid al-Moualem]]  demands the immediate withdrawal of all U.S. and Turkish troops from his country and warns that Syrian government forces have the right to take countermeasures if they refuse. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-un-assembly-syria/syria-demands-withdrawal-of-u-s-turkish-forces-warns-of-countermeasures-idUSKBN1WD0JL (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Afghan presidential election]]
**Voters in [[Afghanistan]] head to the polls to elect a new [[President of Afghanistan|president]]. The process is overshadowed by "insurgent" attacks, which led to dozens of civilian casualties. [https://www.dw.com/en/afghanistan-election-day-violence-leaves-multiple-casualties/a-50618466 (DW)]
**The [[Independent Election Commission (Afghanistan)|Independent Election Commission]] says it has reports that there is no contact with 901 of the 4,942 polling centers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-election-vote/afghanistan-election-commission-has-no-contact-with-some-polling-centers-idUSKBN1WD086 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*The [[Richmond Football Club]] defeats the [[Greater Western Sydney Giants]] in the [[2019 AFL Grand Final]] by 114 points to 25, marking the club's twelfth premiership and second in three years. The match, attended by 100,014 spectators, is the lowest single-match score by the Giants in their history, and the most lopsided Grand Final result in Richmond's history (89 points). [https://www.theage.com.au/sport/afl/supreme-tigers-deliver-roar-lesson-to-giants-20190928-p52vtu.html (''The Age'')]
*[[2019 UCI Road World Championships]]
**[[Annemiek van Vleuten]] wins the [[UCI Road World Championships – Women's road race|women's road race]] after a {{convert|105|km|mi|adj=on}} solo attack, with a lead of 2 min 15 s over second-placed defending champion [[Anna van der Breggen]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2019/sep/28/annemiek-van-vleuten-womens-road-race-world-championship (''The Guardian'')]
